description: Pull official U.S. federal finance figures from the Treasury's Fiscal Data: the national debt to the penny and by kind of security, the debt limit, monthly receipts, spending and deficits, the Treasury's daily cash, tax refunds and revenue collections, average interest rates, official exchange rates, I bond rates and savings bond values, Treasury auction results and records, the gold reserve, gifts to reduce the debt, and any other Fiscal Data dataset. No account or API key is required.
